text.en: Clients consistently praise trainer Jill for her patience, deep behavioural expertise, and non-judgemental coaching style. Dog owners highlight that she builds human handler confidence just as much as training dogs, making training sessions enjoyable and reassuring. Reviewers frequently note that she creates a supportive environment for both puppies and adult dogs.

Pet parents appreciate that training exercises are carefully tailored to each dog distinct personality, drive, and energy level. Clients working with nervous puppies, reactive adolescent dogs, or older pets praise the positive-reinforcement techniques used. Reviewers note that dogs genuinely enjoy the sessions and show visible improvements in trust and calmness.

Reviewers report notable behavioural progress, including improved recall, better impulse control around distractions, and loose-lead walking. Owners highlight that one-to-one coaching provided practical games and management strategies that significantly lowered stress during daily walks. Clients describe the coaching investment as lasting and transformative.

q.en: What training formats are offered by Busy Bee Dog Training?

a.en: The trainer provides one-to-one coaching sessions, group workshops, and online classes including interactive training communities.

q.en: Does the trainer help with reactive or anxious dogs?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently praise Jill for successfully helping dogs overcome nervousness, chasing drives, and adolescent behavioural challenges.

q.en: Where do outdoor in-person training sessions take place?

a.en: Outdoor training sessions and coaching walks are held in local green spaces such as Newlands Park in South Glasgow.
